function.name: create_file
function.description: Creates a file inside the session's folder with the specified filename, extension, and content. Ensures the filename is unique by appending a counter if needed.

filename.description: The base name of the file, without extension. ChatGPT can use this to name the script or document.

extension.description: The file extension, starting with a dot, e.g., .py, .txt, .md

content.description: The text content to write into the file.
